name: Sunami (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Sunami town emblem in white: a stylised character of a winged top above a ring with a disc.
history: Flag of the former town of Sunami in Gifu Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-05-01.

features.role: Sunami town emblem — a stylised character of a winged top above a ring with a disc
